# True Aim

> Neuro-symbolic AI for auditable insurance claims decisions. Swiss precision meets compliant automation.

True Aim builds AI-powered decisioning software for insurance claims. Our hybrid neuro-symbolic approach combines the adaptability of agentic AI with the precision of deterministic logic, delivering compliant, explainable decisions at scale.

## Company

- Name: True Aim AG
- Location: Zug, Switzerland
- Industry: InsurTech / AI
- Website: https://trueaim.ai
- Contact: https://trueaim.ai/en/contact/

## Products

- [Platform overview](https://trueaim.ai/en/platform/): How the products fit together.
- [Invoice Benchmarking](https://trueaim.ai/en/platform/invoice-benchmarking/): Checks every invoice, quote and estimate against benchmark data by trade and region, and shows which lines are too high and why.
- [Automated Coverage Check](https://trueaim.ai/en/platform/automated-coverage-check/): Checks every line of a claim against the policy wording, with the amount calculated and the reason recorded.
- [AI Damage Assessment & Reporting](https://trueaim.ai/en/platform/ai-damage-assessment-and-reporting/): Photos, videos and documents become a detailed damage report, a region-specific repair estimate and a full scope of work at first notification of loss.
- [Otus, True Aim's claims specialist](https://trueaim.ai/en/platform/otus/): Answers questions about a claim in the AI assistant the company has already approved, and explains each decision in plain language.

## Key Differentiators

- Neuro-symbolic architecture: Combines neural AI with deterministic logic
- 100% auditable decisions linked to policy clauses and source documents
- EU AI Act alignment by design
- Swiss-based with enterprise-grade security
